blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Farmers in Narvacan are expected to benefit from improved post-harvest storage and reduced crop spoilage following the inauguration of a solar- and wind-powered modular cold storage facility in the municipality on Monday. The facility, turned over to the municipal government in a ceremony led by Department of Agriculture (DA) Undersecretary for Agro-Marine Industrial Systems Arrey Perez and Regional Executive Director Fidel Libao, is designed to provide sustainable storage for agricultural produce. Mayor Edna Cabalo-Sanidad attended the inauguration, along with Sangguniang Bayan members Jose Corrales Jr. and Benjamin Dela Cuadra Jr., Liga ng mga Barangay President Fidel […]...
